_readme: To add a new product: copy one object inside 'items' below, give it a unique 'slug' and set its 'category' to one of the subcategory slugs in assets/data/product_subcategories.json (and 'gender' to match that subcategory). Add the matching image file under /assets/images/products/<category>/ and re-run scripts/build_site.py.
